description_en: Queries the instances for which the cross-region backup feature is enabled in a region and the cross-region backup settings of these instances
description_zh: 该接口用于查询所选地域的哪些实例开启了跨地域备份，以及这些实例的跨地域备份设置
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-cross-region-backup-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrossRegionBackupDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Up to 30 instance IDs are allowed in a single request. If you enter more than one instance ID, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。一次最多传入30个实例ID，以英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

BackupEnabled.description_en:
The status of the cross-region backup feature on the instance. Valid values:

Disable
Enable
BackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域备份总开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

BackupEnabledTime.description_en: The time when cross-region backup was enabled on the instance. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEnabledTime.description_zh: 跨地域数据备份开启时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the destination region within which the cross-region backup file is stored

CrossBackupType.description_en: The policy that is used to save the cross-region backup files of the instance. Default value: 1. The value 1 indicates that all cross-region backup files are saved
CrossBackupType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。默认值：1，表示每个备份都保存

DBInstanceDescription.description_en:
The name of the instance. It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The value can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter.

The value cannot start with http:// or https://
DBInstanceDescription.description_zh:
实例名称，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头

DBInstanceStatus.description_en: The instance status. For more information, see [Instance statuses]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例状态，详情请参见[实例状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the instance

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the instance. Valid values:

Unlock: The instance is not locked.
ManualLock: The instance is manually locked.
LockByExpiration: The instance is automatically locked after it expires.
LockByRestoration: The instance is automatically locked before it is rolled back.
LockByDiskQuota: The instance is automatically locked because its storage capacity is exhausted and the instance is inaccessible
LockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定状态，取值：
Unlock：正常
ManualLock：手动触发锁定
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定（不可访问实例）

LogBackupEnabled.description_en:
The status of the cross-region log backup feature on the instance. Valid values:

Disable
Enable
LogBackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

LogBackupEnabledTime.description_en: The time when the cross-region log backup feature was enabled on the instance. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogBackupEnabledTime.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份开启时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RetentType.description_en: The policy that is used to retain the cross-region backup files of the instance. Cross-region backups can be retained only based on the specified retention period. Default value: 1
RetentType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。当前仅支持按配置时长保留，默认值：1

Retention.description_en: The number of days for which the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained. Valid values: 7 to 1825
Retention.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：7~1825

ItemsNumbers.description_en: The total number of items returned for cross-region backup settings
ItemsNumbers.description_zh: 跨地域备份设置列表内的Item数量

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 30

TotalRecords.description_en: The total number of entries returned
